objective: Infer compact executable musical relationships through the existing exact Rust codec; preserve observations while recovering useful harmony, voice-leading, rhythm and reusable structure.

checkpoint.summary: The exact Rust codec separates realized palettes from witnessed functional-root proposals. Shipped Mozart K330-I/K331-I strict joint root/core agreement remains 63.04% / 55.93%. Preserving the pretrained quality representation and adapting its final linear map on three separate sonatas in all twelve transpositions, with one fixed atomic decoder, reaches 92.82% / 93.50% joint and 93.54% / 93.99% core agreement. The immutable function branch remains at 98.44% / 98.17% root agreement; original proofs never transfer to changed surface cores. A separately witnessed continuation recovers .75 quarter of K331 function. The teacher has known Mozart training overlap: these are development experiments, not shipped inference or independent validation. Requested 100% remains unmet; strict denominators and observations stay fixed and no holdout is parsed.
nextActions: Close realized-core and boundary errors jointly. Atomic source frames plus explicit pitched-silence holds can represent 100% of supported reference timing; this oracle says nothing about selecting labels. Remaining surface errors include absent suspended-third vocabulary and poorly ranked implied/seventh members. Do not freeze the decoder's selected windows or alter the strict denominator.

Retain the reproducible three-work pretrained quality-readout control. Joint degree/quality correction and the fixed six-work quality fit underperform; no per-work oracle selection or further blind head sweeps. The six-work corpus has abundant V(64) but no I(64) replacements, so transposition alone cannot supply the missing context.

Infer shared parent-to-realization operations through the existing compiler. KEEP versus paired next-degree replacement of third/fifth already passes independent semantic-edit controls. Measure supplied-parent/domain capacity first, then source-only proposal coverage using frozen key/function/numeric-head witnesses. Fit shared candidate-relative evidence only after separating proposal failures; marginalize compatible derivations and preserve implied members separately from emitted notes.

Preserve explicit functional-span evidence separately from native immediate-neighbor proof. Identical core and bass alone are insufficient; the narrow successful continuation also requires uniformly predicted second inversion. Keep unresolved direct-to-tonic and changing-bass cases separate. Retain one maintained capture/fit/decode/evaluate path with immutable function/surface layers and strict source/timebase admission.

Require continuity, independent seventh, ambiguity and track-repartition controls when changing scoring. Missing members can be implied by surrounding harmony; passing/neighbor motion can be structurally chordal. These musical distinctions constrain any learned or hand-written proposal.

Preserve an edited composition program independently of reanalysis. Keep source observations, authored parameters and inferred evidence distinct; a new inverse reading must not erase an authored dependency.
After representation/ranking choices are frozen, evaluate held-out work lineages once, alongside exact reconstruction, useful edits, runtime and explanatory cost.
